terminos.sec1_texto: By using the website and services of La Quinta de Alí, you accept these Terms and Conditions in their entirety. If you disagree with any part, we recommend not using our services.
terminos.sec2_texto: La Quinta de Alí offers private event venue rental in Santiago, Nuevo León, Mexico. Services include the use of facilities according to the contracted package, access via smart lock with a temporary PIN code, and optional extras.
terminos.sec3_texto: To confirm a reservation, full payment of the selected package amount is required in a single transaction. Payments are processed through Openpay and can be made by credit card (up to 12 interest-free months), debit card, or SPEI bank transfer. The payment reference is valid for 48 hours.
terminos.sec4_texto: Cancellations made more than 48 hours before the event are fully refundable. Cancellations made less than 48 hours in advance are non-refundable. To request a cancellation, contact the administrator via WhatsApp.
terminos.sec5_texto: The client is responsible for respecting the maximum capacity of the contracted package, complying with the facility usage rules, covering damages to facilities, furniture or equipment during the event, and respecting the contracted schedule.
terminos.sec6_texto: La Quinta de Alí is not responsible for accidents occurring within the facilities due to misuse. The use of the pool and recreational areas is at the client's own risk.
terminos.sec7_texto: For any questions about these terms, you can contact us via WhatsApp at +52 814 906 0693 or write to our social media.

privacidad.sec1_texto: La Quinta de Alí, located in Santiago, Nuevo León, Mexico, is responsible for the processing of your personal data in accordance with Mexican data protection law (LFPDPPP).
privacidad.sec2_texto: We collect the following personal data: full name, email address, phone/WhatsApp number, digital signature (when accepting the rules), and payment data processed by Openpay (we do not store card data). This data is necessary to process reservations, send confirmations and coordinate event access.
privacidad.sec3_texto: Your personal data will be used to: manage and confirm reservations, process payments through Openpay, generate temporary access PIN codes, send reminders and confirmations via WhatsApp, and improve our services.
privacidad.sec4_texto: Your data may be shared with: Openpay (payment processor), Meta/WhatsApp (for notifications), and Google (if you log in with Google). We do not sell or trade your personal data to third parties.
privacidad.sec5_texto: You have the right to Access, Rectify, Cancel or Oppose the processing of your personal data (ARCO rights). To exercise these rights, contact the administrator via WhatsApp or email.
privacidad.sec6_texto: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy. Any changes will be posted on this page with the corresponding update date.
